title: Narsa qayerdaligini aytish
can_do: Narsa yoki odam qayerda ekanini aniq ayta olasiz
why: «Kalit stol ustida», «Bank kutubxona yonida» — o'rin predloglari bo'lmasa, joyni tushuntira olmaysiz. O'zbek tilida bu qo'shimcha, ingliz tilida — alohida so'z.

points.text: O'zbek tilida joy qo'shimcha bilan ko'rsatiladi: stol-da, stol-ning ost-ida. Ingliz tilida esa otdan OLDIN alohida so'z turadi: on the table, under the table.

examples.en: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.

points.text: Uchta asosiy predlog: in — ichida, on — ustida yoki yuzasida, at — nuqtada. In the box, on the wall, at the door.

examples.en: The keys are in my bag.
The picture is on the wall.
She is at the bus stop.

points.text: Ikki so'zli predloglar ham bor: next to — yonida, in front of — oldida, behind — orqasida, between — orasida, opposite — ro'parasida.

examples.en: The bank is next to the school.
The car is in front of the house.
The shop is between the bank and the café.

points.text: Shahar bilan in, aniq manzil bilan at ishlatiladi: in Tashkent, at 5 Navoi Street. Bu farq ko'p xatoga sabab bo'ladi.

examples.en: I work at 12 Amir Temur Street.

common_errors.wrong: The book is the table on.
common_errors.right: The book is on the table.
common_errors.why: Predlog otdan oldin turadi. O'zbekchadagi qo'shimcha tartibini ko'chirishdan chiqadigan xato.

common_errors.wrong: The bank is near to my house.
common_errors.right: The bank is near my house.
common_errors.why: Near dan keyin to qo'yilmaydi. Lekin «next to» — ikkalasi birga.

common_errors.wrong: The car is in front the house.
common_errors.right: The car is in front of the house.
common_errors.why: «In front of» uch so'zdan iborat, of tushib qolmaydi.

common_errors.wrong: The shop is between the bank with the café.
common_errors.right: The shop is between the bank and the café.

words.example: The keys are in the bag.
The book is on the desk.
The ball is under the table.
The café is next to the bank.
The garden is behind the house.
Wait in front of the door.
It's between the shop and the school.
The park is opposite my house.
Is there a shop near here?
The shop is on the corner.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: rasm yoki tavsifga mos predlogni qo'yish
in / on / at ni to'g'ri tanlash
«near to», «in front the», «at Tashkent» xatolarini topish
o'z xonangizdagi narsalar joyi haqida gap tuzish

final.task: Do'stingiz siznikiga kelmoqchi. Uyingiz qayerdaligini predloglar bilan tushuntiring: nima yonida, nima ro'parasida. 4-5 gap.

skill_task.task: Odam xonasini tasvirlaydi. Qaysi narsa qayerdaligini yozing.
